g.text: Abdul El-Sayed Mocks Trump and Ted Cruz’s Cruel Rhetoric on ‘The View,’ Jokes He Wants ‘Jihadist Leprechaun’ Printed on a Hat ◆ How Grimes’ Cameo in Theater-Bound AI Film ‘Gods Don’t Give Gifts’ Came Together (EXCLUSIVE) ◆ Robert Pattinson to Receive 40th American Cinematheque Award ◆ ‘Dune’ Launches Arrakis-Inspired Press-On Nail Collection With Glamnetic ◆ Katseye’s Megan Skiendiel Fronts Rare Beauty and Warby Parker’s New Eyewear Collaboration ◆ How ‘Frontline’ Turned Into an Oscar-Winning Documentary Juggernaut ◆
